name: OFFAL
source:
The piles of old fallen leaves, pumpkins happily greeting friends, and scary costumes dancing around the city. It's Halloween! Time to party!

Play as Moriah, a tired, anxious student with a passion for drumming in OFFAL, a visual novel set on Halloween. Talk to friends, blow off some steam, and prepare for tonight's festivities.
Bet ready for a scary good time in OFFAL!

[From [url=https://suntann.itch.io/offalgame]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
成堆的落叶、快乐地与朋友打招呼的南瓜，以及在城市周围跳舞的可怕服装。万圣节到了！聚会时间到了！

在以万圣节为背景的视觉小说《OFFAL》中，你将扮演Moriah，一名疲惫、焦虑的学生，对打鼓充满热情。与朋友交谈，发泄一下情绪，为今晚的庆祝活动做准备。
准备好在OFFAL度过一段可怕的美好时光吧！

[来自[url=https://suntann.itch.io/offalgame]itch.io[/url]]
